about.title: About the Ascended Heroes set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Ascended Heroes is a Mega Evolution expansion released on 30 January 2026. It has 295 cards: 217 in the main set and 78 secret rares. There are also 318 reverse holos, Poké Ball holos, Friend Ball holos, Love Ball holos, Quick Ball holos, Dusk Ball holos, Team Rocket holos and Energy Symbol holos.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 217 main set cards), the Master set (535 cards, adding the reverse holos, Poké Ball holos, Friend Ball holos, Love Ball holos, Quick Ball holos, Dusk Ball holos, Team Rocket holos and Energy Symbol holos) or the Grand Master set (all 613 cards, adding the 78 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
